channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Gov. Ivey touts controversial CHOOSE Act in celebration of National School Choice Week
item.description: The governor used her proclamation as an opportunity to push for further state funding of private education.

item.title: Opinion | Alabama needs real online safety, not an ineffective government mandate
item.description: Lawmakers debated two competing bills aimed at protecting youth online, but only one held platforms accountable and empowered parents to set safety rules.

item.title: Opinion | Bridging military service and education
item.description: A new law offering veterans temporary teaching certificates passed the Alabama Senate, providing a meaningful pathway to strengthen teacher recruitment efforts.

item.title: Opinion | It’s time to vote on a comprehensive gaming package
item.description: Conservative estimates suggested a comprehensive gaming package could generate roughly $750 million per year, returning lost revenue to Alabama.

item.title: Fairhope Library loses courier service after APLS cuts state funding
item.description: County ends courier service to Fairhope library after aid compliance ruling, cutting interlibrary loans for Baldwin residents outside limits city.

item.title: Advocates talk ACA tax credit extension, as Senate again prepares for vote
item.description: Alabama's lawmakers are backing competing health affordability plans as the U.S. Senate plans to vote again on extending ACA subsidies.

item.title: Opinion | Alabama high school sports are screwed after politicians got involved
item.description: The bickering among private and public schools over AHSAA rules likely would have been worked out amicably. But then the politicians got involved.

item.title: Opinion | When force replaces law, constitutional order collapses
item.description: Two civilian deaths in Minneapolis raise urgent questions about constitutional limits, immigration enforcement, accountability, and whether federal power still answers to law.

item.title: AHSAA reclassification plan draws criticism from Lt. Gov. Ainsworth
item.description: AHSAA approved a new reclassification system for postseason playoff games, drawing criticism from Lt. Gov. Will Ainsworth over competitive balance.

item.title: Republican candidate files residency challenge against Tommy Tuberville
item.description: The first challenge to Tommy Tuberville's run for governor, based on his residency issues, was filed Tuesday morning.
